beforeTopicNavigation.finding: The model searched the wording of the question in chat repeatedly. The service reported a completed run with no sources. The answer said it could not find the parent's statement. Acceptance failed.

afterTopicNavigation.result: The model returned the undeclared name api_server:present_answer. The observation adapter rejected it before dispatch; the server stored an unavailable result and delivered no grounded answer. An independent gateway test confirms that undeclared names cannot execute handlers.
afterTopicNavigation.readOnlyInspection: Replaying the same query in the scoped search tool returned the confirmed topic key and ID. The native session was already gone. This replay does not establish what the model saw in the earlier run.

beforeQuoteHandoff.finding: The model selected the corrected fact by its scoped topic ID. The final evidence check withheld the draft. Successful retrieval alone did not establish a delivered quote.

quoteHandoff.contract: A fact read supplies quoteAnswer only after re-reading a current, confirmed and scoped fact and verifying the original parent text. present_answer expands its opaque quote handle and the normal independent reviewer evaluates the result.
quoteHandoff.scriptedOutcome: Both passed. Recent used only present_answer and two calls. Cold used search_history, read_memory_facts and present_answer plus independent review. The exact v1 statement and v3 fact were bound. Post-deletion rebuild, late delivery and replay were suppressed.
quoteHandoff.liveOutcome: One metered generation loaded history. Two further Vertex generations returned HTTP 429. The budget guard stopped the next native retry before transport. No search or quoted answer was produced by this run.

mixedQuoteRepair.observedPresentation: The model selected the correct immutable parent quote but added an uncited record_restatement introduction. The independent gate withheld the mixed draft with delivery_review_no_sources. Its evidence payload contained the exact v1 chat source and the v3 fact.
mixedQuoteRepair.change: When a mixed private quotation and restatement lacks paragraph support, present_answer returns the existing history_excerpt_mismatch repair response before terminating the turn. The normal citation checks and independent final review still apply.

finalAcceptance.environment: Product reply HTTP handler in-process with the original local Firebase Auth and Firestore services, native Vertex generator and independent Vertex reviewer. Six unrelated intervening messages separated the question from prior answers.

limitations: Full natural-language acceptance covers the one recorded synthetic parent question in a fresh Runner and bounded conversation window. Earlier failed runs are retained. Provider charges for the unmetered reservations remain unknown.

The supplementary read_work capacity case stops with input_limit at the initial scripted gateway request. Reproduced on unmodified commit 726e3427 and again with the recall fix. This independent test remains failing.
The base checkout has no REQ-003 temporary chat lifecycle to exercise. Rejecting a non-persisted message without model calls only covers the product recall entry.
Untraceable pre-deletion originals in a scoped restore and missing originals restored from a public personal backup remain available to their owner as history, with automatic reuse withheld.
Runtime suppression and authenticated journal replay are verified. Physical deletion of every backup, external copy or historical job was not measured.
No production deployment, broad data migration or corpus-wide semantic retrieval benchmark.
